ex.py: bà bà， wǒ huái yùn le。 zhè shì wǒ nán péng yǒu men de míng dān……
ex.en: Dad, I am pregnant. Here is the list of the suspects...

ex.zh: 我今天晚点下班，省得明天早上手忙脚乱。
ex.py: wǒ jīn tiān wǎn diǎn xià bān， shěng de míng tiān zǎo shàng shǒu máng jiǎo luàn。
ex.en: Today I'm working a little late so as to avoid a rush in the morning.

ex.zh: 没有授粉，我们就吃不到水果和蔬菜。
ex.py: méi yǒu shòu fěn， wǒ men jiù chī bú dào shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài。
ex.en: Without pollination, we wouldn't be able to eat fruits and vegetables.

ex.zh: 他并不怎么努力读书，但成绩却很好。
ex.py: tā bìng bù zěn me nǔ lì dú shū， dàn chéng jì què hěn hǎo。
ex.en: He does not study hard, but does very well at school.

ex.zh: 只要换上不同招牌，就能成为各种商店。
ex.py: zhǐ yào huàn shàng bù tóng zhāo pái， jiù néng chéng wéi gè zhǒng shāng diàn。
ex.en: Only if you put up a different sign can you become a miscellany store.

ex.zh: 既然你要去超市，那就顺便买些鸡蛋吧。
ex.py: jì rán nǐ yào qù chāo shì， nà jiù shùn biàn mǎi xiē jī dàn ba。
ex.en: Since you're going to the supermarket, buy some eggs while you're there.

ex.zh: 这跟我完全没关系，全都是汤姆的事！
ex.py: zhè gēn wǒ wán quán méi guān xì， quán dōu shì tāng mǔ de shì！
ex.en: I've got absolutely nothing to do with it, it's all Tom!

ex.zh: 目前，我正在寻找客服工作，最好是零售业。
ex.py: mù qián， wǒ zhèng zài xún zhǎo kè fú gōng zuò， zuì hǎo shì líng shòu yè。
ex.en: Currently, I'm looking for a job in customer service, preferably retail.

ex.zh: 先生，您把您的打火机留在桌子上了。
ex.py: xiān shēng， nín bǎ nín de dǎ huǒ jī liú zài zhuō zi shàng le。
ex.en: Sir, you have left your lighter on the table.

ex.zh: 我的一个朋友在白天的时候来看我。
ex.py: wǒ de yí gè péng yǒu zài bái tiān de shí hòu lái kàn wǒ。
ex.en: A friend of mine came to see me during the day.

ex.zh: 不好意思，请问这条路通往地铁站吗？
ex.py: bù hǎo yì sī， qǐng wèn zhè tiáo lù tōng wǎng dì tiě zhàn ma？
ex.en: Excuse me, but is this the right way to the subway station?

ex.zh: 你打算去哪些地方旅行？怎么去？为什么？
ex.py: nǐ dǎ suàn qù nǎ xiē dì fāng lǚ xíng？ zěn me qù？ wèi shén me？
ex.en: What places are you planning to visit in your travels? And how? And why?

ex.zh: 今天没有空做晚饭，所以我去买了盒饭。
ex.py: jīn tiān méi yǒu kòng zuò wǎn fàn， suǒ yǐ wǒ qù mǎi le hé fàn。
ex.en: I didn't have time to cook dinner tonight, so I went out and bought a box meal.

ex.zh: 我读小学的时候，我母亲常常来接我。
ex.py: wǒ dú xiǎo xué de shí hòu， wǒ mǔ qīn cháng cháng lái jiē wǒ。
ex.en: When I was in elementary school, my mother always fetched me from school.

ex.zh: 在我们的饭店抓饭，拌面，烤肉串都有。
ex.py: zài wǒ men de fàn diàn zhuā fàn， bàn miàn， kǎo ròu chuàn dōu yǒu。
ex.en: We have pilaf, lo mein, and kebabs in our restaurant.

ex.zh: 人类从语言中学语法，而不是从语法里学语言。
ex.py: rén lèi cóng yǔ yán zhōng xué yǔ fǎ， ér bú shì cóng yǔ fǎ lǐ xué yǔ yán。
ex.en: One learns grammar from language, not language from grammar.

ex.zh: 我点了一份芝麻面包，用来制作素食汉堡。
ex.py: wǒ diǎn le yī fèn zhī má miàn bāo， yòng lái zhì zuò sù shí hàn bǎo。
ex.en: I ordered a sesame seed buns for the veggie burgers.

ex.zh: 没工夫休息的人，早晚会有工夫生病的。
ex.py: méi gōng fu xiū xī de rén， zǎo wǎn huì yǒu gōng fu shēng bìng de。
ex.en: People who cannot find time for recreation are obliged sooner or later to find time for illness.

ex.zh: 她还是个孩子的时候，唱歌很好听。
ex.py: tā hái shì gè hái zi de shí hòu， chàng gē hěn hǎo tīng。
ex.en: She sang well as a child.

ex.zh: 你现在是大学生了，应该努力点读书。
ex.py: nǐ xiàn zài shì dà xué shēng le， yīng gāi nǔ lì diǎn dú shū。
ex.en: Now that you're a college student, you should study harder.

ex.zh: 既然你要去超市，那就顺便买些鸡蛋吧。
ex.py: jì rán nǐ yào qù chāo shì， nà jiù shùn biàn mǎi xiē jī dàn ba。
ex.en: Since you're going to the supermarket, buy some eggs while you're there.

ex.zh: 当你坐在一把舒适的椅子上的时候，更容易学习。
ex.py: dāng nǐ zuò zài yī bǎ shū shì de yǐ zi shàng de shí hòu， gèng róng yì xué xí。
ex.en: It is easier to study when you are sitting in a comfortable chair.

ex.zh: 小朋友们经常给圣诞老人写信，许下自己的愿望。
ex.py: xiǎo péng yǒu men jīng cháng gěi shèng dàn lǎo rén xiě xìn， xǔ xià zì jǐ de yuàn wàng。
ex.en: Children often send letters to Santa with their wishes.

ex.zh: 他刚刚才吃完午饭，不可能会肚子饿。
ex.py: tā gāng gāng cái chī wán wǔ fàn， bù kě néng huì dù zi è。
ex.en: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.

ex.zh: 因为我母亲今天病了，会由我父亲做饭。
ex.py: yīn wèi wǒ mǔ qīn jīn tiān bìng le， huì yóu wǒ fù qīn zuò fàn。
ex.en: Today my mother is sick, so my father will cook.

ex.zh: 如果明天下雨的话，我就不去野餐了。
ex.py: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ de huà， wǒ jiù bù qù yě cān le。
ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go to the picnic.

ex.zh: 他把杯子举到嘴边，一饮而尽。
ex.py: tā bǎ bēi zi jǔ dào zuǐ biān， yī yǐn ér jǐn。
ex.en: He raised the glass to his lips and drained it at one gulp.

ex.zh: 她是外国人，不过她中文说得非常好。
ex.py: tā shì wài guó rén， bù guò tā zhōng wén shuō dé fēi cháng hǎo。
ex.en: She’s a foreigner, but speaks Chinese excellently.

ex.zh: 我今早起床时，我爸已经吃过早饭了。
ex.py: wǒ jīn zǎo qǐ chuáng shí， wǒ bà yǐ jīng chī guò zǎo fàn le。
ex.en: My father had already finished breakfast when I got up this morning.

en: (used in negative expressions) (not) the least bit

ex.zh: 我在二手书店看到一本书，现在它成为了我最爱的书。
ex.py: wǒ zài èr shǒu shū diàn kàn dào yī běn shū， xiàn zài tā chéng wéi le wǒ zuì ài de shū。
ex.en: A book I happened to come across at a secondhand bookstore has now become my favorite.

ex.zh: 她没有在星期天来找我，而是星期一。
ex.py: tā méi yǒu zài xīng qī tiān lái zhǎo wǒ， ér shì xīng qī yī。
ex.en: She did not visit me on Sunday but on Monday.

ex.zh: 医生在给病人看病。
ex.py: yī shēng zài gěi bìng rén kàn bìng。
ex.en: The doctor was giving a patient a checkup.

ex.zh: 如果你感到无聊，我建议你去电影院。
ex.py: rú guǒ nǐ gǎn dào wú liáo， wǒ jiàn yì nǐ qù diàn yǐng yuàn。
ex.en: If you're bored, I suggest you go to the cinema.

en: (fig.) (esp. of a sports coach) to be dismissed

ex.zh: 上课时她是我们的老师，下课以后是我们的朋友，而且是很好的朋友。
ex.py: shàng kè shí tā shì wǒ men de lǎo shī， xià kè yǐ hòu shì wǒ men de péng yǒu， ér qiě shì hěn hǎo de péng yǒu。
ex.en: In class she's our teacher; after class she's our friend, and a good friend too.

ex.zh: 在中国，南方人以米饭为主食，北方人以面食为主食。
ex.py: zài zhōng guó， nán fāng rén yǐ mǐ fàn wéi zhǔ shí， běi fāng rén yǐ miàn shí wéi zhǔ shí。
ex.en: In China, southern people eat rice as staple food; northern people eat wheaten food as staple food.

ex.zh: 在中文里面，饺子和“交子”谐音，因而具有丰富的文化涵义。
ex.py: zài zhōng wén lǐ miàn， jiǎo zi hé “ jiāo zi” xié yīn， yīn ér jù yǒu fēng fù de wén huà hán yì。
ex.en: In Chinese, 'dumpling' and 'first exchange' are homophones, so they have a rich cultural association.

ex.zh: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
ex.py: zhè ge wèn tí ràng xiǎo xué shēng jiě jué tài nán le。
ex.en: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.

ex.zh: 学友来看林老师的时候，外边正下着雨呢。
ex.py: xué yǒu lái kàn lín lǎo shī de shí hòu， wài biān zhèng xià zhe yǔ ne。
ex.en: When Xueyou came to see Teacher Lin, it was raining outside.

ex.zh: 他只不过是个普普通通的中学生，不算特别聪明。
ex.py: tā zhǐ bù guò shì gè pǔ pǔ tōng tōng de zhōng xué shēng， bù suàn tè bié cōng míng。
ex.en: He's just a normal junior high school student, not particularly intelligent.

ex.zh: 我们通常以为只有在星期日和假期，时间才属于我们自己。
ex.py: wǒ men tōng cháng yǐ wéi zhǐ yǒu zài xīng qī rì hé jià qī， shí jiān cái shǔ yú wǒ men zì jǐ。
ex.en: We tend to think that our time is our own only on Sundays and holidays.

ex.zh: 日语和汉语的汉字发音截然不同，对吗？
ex.py: rì yǔ hé hàn yǔ de hàn zì fā yīn jié rán bù tóng， duì ma？
ex.en: The Japanese and Chinese pronunciation for kanji is very different, isn't it?

ex.zh: 你要是再给我们公司出洋相，我可就不客气了。
ex.py: nǐ yào shì zài gěi wǒ men gōng sī chū yáng xiàng， wǒ kě jiù bú kè qì le。
ex.en: If you make fun of our company again, we certainly won’t be polite to you.

ex.zh: 对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。
ex.py: duì zhī shí de ài hào ér yán， wǒ zhēn de xǐ huān xué hàn zì。
ex.en: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.
